Its services are primarily designed for online retail and flash-sale-based purchasing.

product.name: Hushday Private Flash Sales Platform
product.description: A mobile-first, referral-only e-commerce platform offering limited-time flash sales on premium brand products in the Middle East.

product.name: Hushday Membership and Referral System
product.description: An invitation-based membership system requiring referral codes or application approval to access the private sales platform.

product.name: Hushday Payment and Checkout Services
product.description: Secure payment processing supporting multiple payment methods including credit cards and installment options for purchases on the platform.

identifier.value: Hushday Order Fulfillment and Delivery Service

product.name: Hushday Order Fulfillment and Delivery Service
product.description: Management of order processing, shipping, and delivery tracking for products purchased through the platform within the UAE.

product.name: Hushday Returns and Refunds Service
product.description: A process for members to return eligible items within 14 days and receive refunds or store credit, with specific product exclusions.
